notes: Temperature printed as 25 °C (stored 298.15 K). Volumetric measurement on BELSORP HP (Microtrac); amounts from the pressure difference observed in 1000 s at each pressure. Paper calls the quantity 'uptake of adsorbed H2 gas' and names no basis; basis_inferred = excess by the volumetric default. Dead volume is measured after evacuation (p. 14725) but the method/gas is not described, so calibration_described = false. Degassing conditions before the H2 measurement and sample mass are not stated. H2 purity printed as >99.99999% (stored 99.99999). Pressure axis read in MPa and converted x10 to bar; not stated as gauge. Only the highest-pressure point of this 25 °C isotherm is extracted (non-77 K rule). BET range: 0.05–0.20 (P/P0). Surface area by N2 adsorption at −196 °C (ASAP 2020). Micropore volume by DR (N2); total pore volume from N2 adsorbed at P/P0 = 0.96; mesopore volume = Vtotal − Vmicro. Sample is a mixture of CB/Pt and organic compound-adsorbed AC (MSP20N) at a CB-to-AC weight ratio of 1:100; 5 mmol of compound per 1 g of AC dried under vacuum at 150 °C for 1 h, adsorbed for 24 h in a sealed vial. Pt loading of the mixture is not stated (CB:Pt 50:1 and CB:AC 1:100 printed), so metal_loading_wt_pct is left empty. Whether wt% is per g of mixture or per g of AC is not stated. Surface area and pore volumes stored are the per-g-sample values (Table column a); CB/Pt = Pt nanoparticles (~2 nm) on carbon black DENKA BLACK Li-100 (Denka, ~30 nm particles), CB:Pt 50:1 by weight, from PtMe2COD (Sigma-Aldrich) heated in a sealed evacuated ampoule at 300 °C for 1 h and 500 °C for 3 h. Run with H2 exposure time 5000 s at each pressure (total 31.9 h); conversion of 16 63% (H/16 = 1.25). The uptake includes H consumed by irreversible hydrogenation of 16 and the authors state the reaction did not reach equilibrium at each pressure. replicates_reported = true because two isotherms of this sample are reported (1000 s and 5000 s exposure, I4 and I5), though they differ in exposure time. normalized per g AC (Table 2 column e): SBET 26 m2 g-1, Vtotal 0.02, Vmicro 0.01, Vmeso 0.01 cm3 g-1. area_same_sample = unclear: N2 measured on the mixture, but not stated whether before or after hydrogenation of 16. 16 adsorbed at 55 °C (Table S1). Archive covers only the P >= 1.6 MPa part of the triangle series (separation from the 1000 s circles and the legend). isotherm_point_count = markers counted: 11 closed + 11 open triangles; markers near 0 MPa overlap, count approximate. Digitized point: 3.1824 MPa, 0.28259 wt%. archive: fig5a_16_5000s_triangles_closed.json C (reconciliation): row kept from extractor B (A has no rows for 16). Identifiers assigned by C: sample HYC-0131-S7 for both runs of 16; 5000 s run = I7 / HYC-0131-M7 (B's I4/M4), 1000 s run = I8 / HYC-0131-M8 (B's I5/M5). Value and pressure from B's digitization only; uncertainty = 1% of axis span (digitized_means line 7). The Fig. 5a legend bracket points all series, both 16 series included, to the left H2/wt% axis. C sets area_same_sample = yes (Table 2 reports the AC containing 16, the as-prepared state; the AC containing 14, never run as an H2 isotherm, was also measured, so N2 samples were as prepared) and calibration_described = true (dead volume measured after evacuation, p. 14725), superseding the statements above.
